errors.text_span: der Kupferanteil stieg von 4,4 % im Jahr 2021 auf 5,1 % im Jahr 2022
errors.evidence: The machine description states that the copper percentage in the EU increased from 4.4% in 2021 to 5.1% in 2022, but the chart shows no explicit indication of a trend or comparison between years.
The machine description does not mention that the chart represents the share of Russian imports of industrial raw materials in Germany and the EU.
The machine description does not mention that the chart consists of two separate bar charts, one for Germany and one for the EU.
The machine description does not specify that the vertical axis represents percentages.
The machine description does not mention the exact values for each year and material as shown in the chart.
